 TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Nov 20, 2026, 17:46 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Ketan Karande, an actor and bodybuilder, caused a stir on a recent podcast by claiming he was once employed as Aishwarya Rai Bachchan ’s bodyguard to protect her from Salman Khan . He recalled that he quit the very next day after coming face-to-face with the superstar. Ketan Karande claims he was Aishwarya Rai Bachchan’s bodyguard
 During his appearance on Art Media Entertainment, Ketan said, “Kisiko maine bataya nahi ki main Aishwarya ka bodyguard tha.” Explaining why he was hired, he added, “Salman ke liye hi rakha tha.” When the host asked him to elaborate, the actor clarified, “Matlab Salman se bachne ke liye mujhe rakha tha.” Watch Aishwarya Rai turns heads with red hair, regal couture and starry moments at Paris Fashion Week Ketan Karande on being hired during Salman-Aishwarya fallout
 Asked whether Salman knew about his appointment, Ketan replied, “Salman ji ko pata hoga shayad se, bahot saal ho gaye.” He claimed he was hired close to 20 years ago, when talk of Salman and Aishwarya’s relationship and their eventual fallout was dominating headlines.  Describing his job, Ketan said he had to pick Aishwarya up from her home, travel with her in the car and make sure she reached her shoot location safely. He added that this was while she was shooting for 'Kuch Naa Kaho'. When Ketan Karande ran into Salman Khan after a fashion show
 He recounted an episode from a fashion show organised by filmmaker Vikram Bhatt , where he had escorted Aishwarya after picking her up from her home. The situation turned tense when they ran into Salman once the show ended. Describing that moment, he said, “Waha par hi same waise hi madam ko ghar se liya gadi mein baithe aur chal pade. Ab show khatam hua waha se nikle to Salman Khan sahab saamne to ham sab aise dar gaye ki kya karna hai.” Why Ketan Karande quit as Aishwarya Rai Bachchan’s bodyguard
 Ketan said he initially assumed he would have to step out of the car, but the driver advised him against it and took a turn to steer them away from the situation. Speaking about his decision to quit, he said, “Maine second day job diya, maine kaha nahi karna hai.” Questioned on why he left, he suggested that Salman could be carrying a gun, saying, “Unke paas hoti hai shayad se.” He also noted that the job was interfering with his bodybuilding career, which led him to walk away.
